content.text:
I built the site as a single static page, `index.html`, in your project folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is untested.

It uses everything in `copy.md` and the images in `images/`:
- **Header:** a sticky bar with the logo, a dropdown menu (The Event, The Race and Competitors each have sub-menus), and Facebook and Twitter icons. On mobile the menu collapses behind a button.
- **Hero:** `image-01.jpg` as the background, with the race title, the tagline and the 31 January – 2 February 2020 date.
- **News:** the Bathurst 12 Hour 2022 return story as a wide featured card, then the other six stories as a grid. It drops to two columns and then one on smaller screens.
- **Footer:** the "follow us" text and social links, the Contacts, Media, Privacy and Terms links, a grid of all the sponsor logos, and the © line with the footer logo.

I made two small fixes of my own:
- **McLaren sponsor:** `copy.md` has no logo image for McLaren, so I used a text label linked to its sponsor page.
- **Alt text:** I wrote the sponsor logos' alt text myself from the filenames, and left the news photos' alt text empty.

I left the links as they appear in `copy.md`. Most go to the live bathurst12hour.com.au site, and Home and News stay as `/` and `/news`, which will only work if you host those pages.

I also guessed that the header logo works on a dark background. If it looks wrong, switch the header and page colours to a light theme.
